About the Role

Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases

  • Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks

  • Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly

  • Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need

  • Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases

  • Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules

  • Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results

  • Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live

  • Use production results to keep improving the model

  • Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them

  • Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field

  • Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster

  • Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation

An ideal candidate has

  • Run the full post-training loop end to end themselves, from data preparation through fine-tuning an open-weight model, evaluation and serving, rather than only calling a vendor’s fine-tuning service

  • Working experience with supervised fine-tuning and at least one of preference optimization or reinforcement learning, including parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA

  • Strong Python and command of the standard training stack, for example PyTorch, Hugging Face and vLLM, with comfort running jobs on rented or customer GPUs

  • Built benchmarks and graders from messy real-world data and used them to show that one model beats another on quality, cost and latency

  • A habit of thinking in held-out sets, baselines and ablations, and can explain a result’s limits as clearly as its headline

  • At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews

  • Confidence presenting to and pushing back on senior customer stakeholders, including data and technology leaders

  • Strong data engineering skills across SQL, pipelines, PII handling and redaction

  • An understanding of the privacy, security and model-risk requirements of regulated customers such as banks and airlines

  • Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partners, plus a base in the Eastern or Central time zone with daily overlap across the partner and Research teams you work with

  • Bonus: forward-deployed, applied research or applied AI experience at an AI-native company that trains its own models for a domain

  • Bonus: multilingual training and evaluation, or experience with travel, airline or banking systems and data such as PSS, GDS, NDC, ticketing, loyalty and contact-centre data

  • Bonus: experience with agent systems and tool use, or working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

  • 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees

  • Access to Disability & Life insurance

  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)

  • DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.

  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.

  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!
